tools.name: get_stock_summary
tools.description: Compact fundamentals summary for one ticker (~5 KB): latest close, market cap, valuation ratios, margins, returns, dividend record, and 3/5/10-year growth CAGRs, with as-of dates and applicability notes. Null values are honest gaps or sector-inappropriate metrics — never zeros.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: The full metric catalog: slug, label, unit, basis (daily/monthly/annual/quarterly/ttm — the stored sampling density, never overstated), methodology, and whether each metric is available as a JSON series (get_metric_series) and/or a chart render (get_chart).

tools.name: get_metric_series
tools.description: Historical series for a TGMCharts-computed metric (daily valuation/yield lines, rolling TTM flows, quarterly margins). Points are even-time downsampled to max_points (default 120) to stay token-frugal — raw density is available at https://tgmcharts.com/api/v1/series/{symbol}/{metric}. points:null =

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: A ready-to-embed 1600×900 PNG chart of a metric's history in TGMCharts' house style (watermarked, as-of stamped). Returns the canonical URL — fetch or embed it directly (); it is edge-cached and needs no key. Sector-gated or empty histories render an honest explanation card rather than fa

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.description: Raw as-filed statement rows (income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow) sourced exclusively from SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts — public domain, latest-filed per period, honest nulls (never zero-filled, never vendor-backfilled). Derived quarters are disclosed. Token-frugal default: 5 fiscal years

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Side-by-side headline fundamentals for 2–4 tickers (latest values with as-of context): market cap, close, P/E, P/S, margins, ROE, dividend yield, and 5-year revenue/EPS CAGRs. Uncovered symbols are reported honestly, not dropped silently.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Filter and rank the covered universe (about 4,000 US-listed names) on fundamental fields (marketCap, peRatio, dividendYield, consecutiveYears, margins, 5y CAGRs, …). Returns at most 25 rows — the MCP tier's cap; the full screener lives at https://tgmcharts.com/screener.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "compare_stocks" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
